datasets.title: Materials Project Computed Materials Database
datasets.description: High-throughput density functional theory (DFT) calculations, crystalline structures, electronic band structures, and thermodynamic phase diagrams for over 150,000 inorganic compounds.

datasets.title: NOMAD Computational Materials Science Archive
datasets.description: FAIR repository and archive for computational materials science data, containing millions of raw, parsed, and normalized input and output files from ab initio and molecular dynamics codes.

datasets.title: PubChem Bioactive Substances and Compounds
datasets.description: Open chemistry database at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) providing chemical structures, biological activities, physical properties, and safety annotations for hundreds of millions of compounds.

datasets.title: ChEMBL Bioactive Drug-Like Molecules Database
datasets.description: Manually curated database of bioactive molecules with drug-like properties, binding affinities, functional assays, and target protein associations extracted from medicinal chemistry literature.

datasets.title: UniProtKB Comprehensive Protein Sequence and Function Knowledgebase
datasets.description: Universal Protein Resource providing accurately curated, non-redundant protein sequences, functional domain annotations, ontology mappings (Gene Ontology), and cross-references.

datasets.title: Wikidata Semantic Web Core Knowledge Graph
datasets.description: Structured multilingual knowledge base collecting linked open data statements, item identifiers, ontology cross-references, and semantic classifications across scientific domains.

datasets.title: Crystallography Open Database (COD)
datasets.description: Open-access collection of crystal structures of organic, inorganic, metal-organic compounds and minerals, excluding biopolymers, validated with full CIF crystallographic data.

datasets.title: Open Reaction Database (ORD)
datasets.description: Open-access schema and structured data repository for organic and chemical reaction datasets, reaction conditions, yields, kinetic data, and laboratory automation protocols.

datasets.title: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) Adsorption Energy Dataset
datasets.description: Dataset of 1.3 million molecular relaxations and 130 million DFT calculations of molecular adsorptions onto heterogeneous catalytic surfaces for renewable energy discovery.
datasets.publisher: Meta AI Research & Carnegie Mellon University

datasets.title: Materials Genome Initiative Benchmark Phase Data
datasets.description: Standard reference database of experimentally validated high-temperature phase equilibria, alloy thermodynamic data, and mechanical stress-strain curves.
datasets.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

datasets.title: PoLyInfo Polymer Property and Structure Database
datasets.description: Curated database of polymeric materials covering homopolymers, copolymers, thermal transition temperatures, glass transition, crystallinity, and dielectric properties.
datasets.publisher: National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS, Japan)

datasets.title: MatPortal Curated Materials Semantic Corpus
datasets.description: Curated semantic dataset linking standardized ontologies (EMMO, PMDco, BFO) to materials experiments, characterization workflows, and microstructure measurements.
datasets.publisher: MatPortal Consortium / Materials Science Semantic Community
